reason: On Linux x86_64 with Python 3.12.3, the published uv 0.11.26 and 0.12.0–0.12.3 binaries all accepted the reported same-directory `--find-links=./private_wheels/` fixture. `uv pip compile requirements.in -o requirements.txt --no-index` and `uv pip install --dry-run -r requirements.in --no-index` reached dependency resolution, not the reported URL error. With a trusted `ok==1.0.0` wheel in that directory, uv 0.12.3 completed both commands successfully; equals, whitespace, bare-path, and absolute requirements-file variants also succeeded. astral-sh/uv#20832’s subdirectory behavior was independently confirmed as failing through 0.12.0 and succeeding from 0.12.1. Existing coverage is `crates/uv/tests/pip_install/pip_install.rs`, test `find_links_relative_to_requirements_file`, which successfully installs from a links directory beside a nested requirements file. Reproducing the reported macOS result requires verbose uv version output, working directory and path metadata, and a literal representation of the requirements file. The issue-context README was updated accordingly.
